summary: Defer an Immediate queued from inside an executing Immediate until the next event-loop iteration.

target.notes: Use the Node-compatible event-loop runtime; do not map ordering to arbitrary Task/ThreadPool scheduling.

semantics.nested_immediate: not appended to the currently executing check-phase batch
semantics.ordering: already queued peer Immediates run before nested Immediate
semantics.iteration: nested Immediate becomes eligible on a later event-loop iteration

caveats: Appending directly to the currently draining list would incorrectly run nested callbacks too early.
